LEAKIX_SEARCH_MODE.title: LEAKIX_SEARCH_MODE
LEAKIX_SEARCH_MODE.description: Search mode: 'strict' (default) returns only exact matches for the scanned asset. 'permissive' returns all results from the netblock/AS (may include thousands of unrelated assets).

LEAKIX_EXTRACT_ASN.title: LEAKIX_EXTRACT_ASN
LEAKIX_EXTRACT_ASN.description: Extract the autonomous system (AS number and organization) reported by LeakIX.

LEAKIX_EXTRACT_CERTIFICATES.title: LEAKIX_EXTRACT_CERTIFICATES
LEAKIX_EXTRACT_CERTIFICATES.description: Extract TLS certificates (X509Certificate) and their SAN hostnames from LeakIX events.

LEAKIX_EXTRACT_SOFTWARE.title: LEAKIX_EXTRACT_SOFTWARE
LEAKIX_EXTRACT_SOFTWARE.description: Extract detected software (service software, modules, HTTP Server and X-Powered-By headers, operating system) from LeakIX events.

LEAKIX_EXTRACT_SSH.title: LEAKIX_EXTRACT_SSH
LEAKIX_EXTRACT_SSH.description: Extract SSH server software from SSH banners in LeakIX events.

LEAKIX_EXTRACT_TLS.title: LEAKIX_EXTRACT_TLS
LEAKIX_EXTRACT_TLS.description: Report findings for outdated TLS/SSL protocol versions (SSLv2/SSLv3/TLS 1.0/TLS 1.1) observed by LeakIX.
